items.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
items.summary: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

items.title: French Hill’s race still too close to call as House flips, changing the direction of crypto legislation
items.summary: As of Wednesday afternoon, House Financial Services Committee Chair French Hill's race for reelection is too close to call.

items.title: Lightning Labs Releases LND Mitigation for Critical Linux Flaw
items.summary: LND v0.20.7-beta and v0.21.6-beta disable Multipath TCP by default, but operators still need a patched kernel to fix the underlying vulnerability.

items.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
items.summary: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.
